scheme_name: Mahatma Jyothiba Phule Overseas Vidya Nidhi for BC and EBC Students
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to Backward Classes (BC) or Economically Backward Classes (EBC)
Only one child from a family is eligible (self‑certificate required)
Minimum 60% marks or equivalent in the qualifying degree
Must have a valid TOEFL/IELTS/GRE/GMAT/PTE score
Must obtain admission to an accredited foreign university
Must be a resident of Telangana
Must join the university within one year of selection notification
Cannot change the sanctioned course of study
Candidate must arrange for the appropriate visa
33% of the awards are earmarked for women candidates
Relaxation of the 60% marks requirement is possible based on test scores and unconditional admission
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹20 lakh scholarship for tuition and living expenses, along with loan assistance, travel ticket, visa fee reimbursement and opportunities for research/teaching assistance.
documents_required: Self‑certificate confirming only one child from the family
Landing permit / I‑94 card / Visa stamping / Boarding pass
Admission letter from an accredited foreign university
